about_us.headline:
Master your
professional destiny.
about_us.desc_p1: Career Compass was born from a simple observation: the gap between academic preparation and market demand is widening. Our mission is to provide every professional with a high-precision navigation system powered by AI to master their destiny.
about_us.v1_desc: We don't just show jobs; we map your unique skill DNA against the entire market.
about_us.v2_desc: Our AI provides objective feedback on your resume, mimicking the most advanced ATS systems.
about_us.v3_desc: Real-time data from thousands of sources to keep you ahead of hiring trends.
about_us.why_p1: The modern job market operates at light speed. Skills that were relevant two years ago are now foundational, and new domains emerge every season. Professionals are often left guessing what to learn next.
about_us.why_p2: We built Career Compass to remove the guesswork. By leveraging state-of-the-art NLP and market-scraping technologies, we provide a live roadmap for your career. Whether you're a junior dev or a senior architect, we help you identify exactly what's missing and how to get there.

terms_page.title: Terms of Service
terms_page.s1_desc: Career Compass provides an AI-powered career navigation platform. By using our service, you agree to provide accurate professional information for analysis. Misuse of the scraping engine or unauthorized access to our API is strictly prohibited.
terms_page.s2_desc: The platform architecture, AI algorithms, and branding are the property of Career Intelligence Inc. No part of our service may be reproduced or reverse-engineered.
terms_page.s3_desc: While our AI provides high-precision data, Career Compass is a tool for professional growth. We do not guarantee employment, and users are responsible for verifying job details with employers.
terms_page.s4_desc: In no event shall Career Compass be liable for any indirect, incidental, or special damages arising from your professional career decisions based on our analysis.
terms_page.agree: By creating an account, you agree to these terms.
terms_page.notice_desc: We reserve the right to update these terms at any time. Major changes will be communicated via the email address registered with your Career Compass account.

privacy_page.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_page.s1_desc: We collect information you provide directly, including your resume data, employment history, and contact details necessary for our AI to perform gap analysis and job matching.
privacy_page.s2_title: 2. Use of AI and Data Processing
privacy_page.s2_desc: Your data is processed transiently by our AI microservices to generate match scores. We do not sell your personal data to third-party recruiters or advertisers.
privacy_page.s3_desc: We employ industry-standard encryption protocols (TLS 1.3) to protect your data in transit and at rest. Access to the administrative backend is strictly role-based (RBAC).
privacy_page.s4_desc: You have the right to request deletion of your account and associated CV data at any time via the profile settings. Deleted data is permanently purged from our primary clusters.
privacy_page.agree: Your privacy is a core architectural requirement.
privacy_page.notice_desc: For GDPR compliance or general privacy inquiries, please contact our Data Protection Officer.
